  • Constructor Details

    • Cell

      public Cell(String name, boolean scorable, double range, double bearing, double elevation)
      Constructs a Cell with the specified properties and determines its color and location based on its name.
      Parameters:
      name - the name identifier of the cell, used to derive color and location
      scorable - true if the cell is in a scorable orientation, false otherwise
      range - the distance from the camera to the cell in inches
      bearing - the horizontal angle to the cell in degrees
      elevation - the vertical angle to the cell in degrees
